items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Bobby, his brother Bobby Johnson, he played guitar and banjo and banjoreen(?) and this-that-and-the-other. He worked with Charlie Johnson's band for years.

ctx.x: No. None whatsoever. No, his brother was... He was really something. He was really a big attraction, his brother was, his oldest brother. Well, the whole family was musical. And they were good musicians. Bobby, his brother Bobby Johnson, he played guitar and banjo and banjoreen(?) and this-that-and-the-other. He worked with Charlie Johnson's band for years. Then he went with Chick Webb's band. He was very good, very outstanding.
Now, he at one time got a saxophone.
